cohort: The study included 198 women with singleton pregnancies who received prenatal care and delivered between July 1, 2019, and December 31, 2022, with GDM risk calculable for 180 participants.
finding: Late screening for Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) was associated with a higher likelihood of large-for-gestational age (LGA) babies.
mod_finding: Pre-pregnancy BMI was identified as the best predictor for caesarean section.
